questions.question: ________ was the first Mughal emperor in India.
questions.solution:
__
 
• **Babur was the founder of the Mughal Empire and the first Mughal emperor in India.**__

questions.question: The leader of the Bhakti movement focusing on Lord Rama was ________.
questions.solution:
__
 
• The leader of the Bhakti movement focusing on Lord Rama was **Ramananda**__.
 
• He was a 14th century Vaishnava poet who founded the Ramanadi Sampradaya.
 
• He taught that Lord Rama is the supreme Lord, and that salvation could be attained only through love for and devotion to him, and through the repetition of his sacred name.
 
• Bhakti movement was a devotional trend that saw its emergence in medieval Hinduism and was revolutionized in Sikhism.
 
• Some of the popular saints of the Bhakti Movement include Ramananda, Chaitanya, Jaydeva, Vivekananda, and Namdeva, etc.

questions.question: Bihar Diwas is celebrated on ________ across the state to commemorate the day when Bihar was carved out of the Bengal Presidency in the year 1912.
questions.solution:
__
 
• Bihar Diwas is celebrated on **March 22**__ across the state every year.
 
• On this day, in 1912, Bihar was carved out of the Bengal Presidency.
 
• It is a public holiday in Bihar.
 
• The year 2021 marked the 109th foundation day of the state.

questions.question: In March 2019, Superstats, a new metrics to analyse the game of ________ was launched by Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Madras researchers and ESPNcricinfo experts.

questions.question: The terms 'Zat and Sawar' are related to which of the following administrative systems?
questions.solution:
__
 
• Zat and Sawar are related to the **Mansabdari administrative system.**__
 
• Mansabdar was a military unit introduced by Akbar.
 
• It means position or rank.
 
• The mansab had dual representation, one was cavalry rank called sawar, while the other was personal rank called zat.

questions.question: What is Marble Cancer?

options.text: Corrosion of marble due to acid rain
Disease in animals due to marble mines
Soil degradation due to marble mines
Cancer in human due to working in mines

questions.solution:
__
 
• **Marble cancer is the corrosion of statues and buildings made up of marbles by the action of nitric acid or sulphuric acid.**__
 
• It also happens because of __**acid rain**__. This rain corrodes the marble monuments by dissolving the calcium and making salt.
 
• Yellowing of Taj Mahal is one of the examples of marble cancer.

questions.question: Metal oxides are ________ in nature.
questions.solution:
__
 
• Metal oxides are** basic**__ in nature since they react with dilute acids to form water and salt.
 
• Metal oxides dissolve in water to form metal hydroxides (alkaline in nature).
 
• Non-metal oxides are acidic in nature.

questions.question: In case the President of India wants to resign, he would address his resignation to the ________.
questions.solution:
__
 
• In case the President of India wants to resign, he would address his resignation to the **Vice President**__.
 
• This has been mentioned in article 56 of the Indian Constitution.
 
• The term of the President is of 5 years.
 
• The Prime Minister and the Vice President address their resignations to the President of India.

questions.question: Tsunami is caused by ________.
questions.solution:
__
 
• **Tsunami is caused by underwater volcanic activity.**__
 
• A sudden movement of the ocean because of earthquakes or landslides on the sea floor causes tsunami waves.
 
• They can also be initiated because of volcanic eruptions beneath the sea, but that is a rare phenomenon.

questions.question: Which of the following are amongst the few carbon-containing compounds NOT classified as organic?
questions.solution:
__
 
• **Cyanides**__, carbides and carbonates are amongst the few carbon-containing compounds which are not classified as organic.
 
• The carbon atom is not considered as an organic compound since it is bonded with 2 oxygen atoms.
 
• Methane is a chemical compound that has the formula CH₄.
 
• Nucleic acids are biomolecules or biopolymers which are essential for all life forms.
 
• Propane is a hydrocarbon gas, also called as LPG.
